name: Ichimoku Itto Read
summary: Type a symbol. Claude rebuilds the Ichimoku Itto dashboard on 1H, 4H, 1D and 1W, adds the classic Ichimoku components, and explains the state by principle in a chat summary and a clean HTML report.
stateOnly: It describes state only. No buy or sell calls, entries, stops or targets. You make every decision.
language: English edition: the skill writes its reports in English.

features.title: Ichimoku Itto dashboard
features.text: Score, Zone, Kumo, the 1H / 4H / D / W rows and Trend, computed with the indicator's own rules.

features.title: Score breakdown
features.text: The five checks behind the Score: Kumo, Tenkan/Kijun, Chikou, future Kumo and Kijun slope.

features.title: Classic Ichimoku
features.text: Price vs Kumo, Tenkan vs Kijun, Chikou, future Kumo and Sanyaku 三役 on each timeframe.

features.title: Marks and magnets
features.text: The last Strong Up / Down and 3/3 Aligned marks, plus flat Kijun and Span B levels.

features.title: Change points
features.text: Prices where a component would change state. They describe state, not trade levels.

features.title: Two sides, equal weight
features.text: What supports the current state, and what to watch for a change.

requirements: Claude on any plan with Skills (web, desktop or mobile), or Claude Code
Code execution turned on in Claude
One price-data route: the TradingView connector, CSV files or a screenshot
noNeed: No API keys and no Python packages. The scripts use the Python standard library only and download nothing while they run.

installApp.title: Claude (web / desktop)
steps: Download ichimoku-itto-read-en.zip from this page. Keep it zipped.
In Claude, open Settings → Capabilities and turn on Code execution and file creation (newer layouts: Create and edit files).
Go to Customize → Skills, click + → Create skill → Upload a skill, and choose the zip.
Make sure the skill is switched on. For the easiest data route, also add the TradingView connector.
installApp.note: Team or Enterprise: an owner must allow Skills and Code execution first.

installCode.title: Claude Code
steps: Copy the folder so the file sits at the path below.
Start Claude Code and type a command, for example ichimoku-itto-read-en XAUUSD.

update: To update: remove the old skill, then upload the new zip (or replace the folder in Claude Code).

presetGuide.lede: The skill reads with Classic on 1D unless you say otherwise. Set the preset, chart TF and TF rows to match your Ichimoku Itto before the first run, or the numbers will not match your chart. From v0.3.3 every report adds a Guide tip that names the preset this guide uses for your market and chart TF; the skill never switches it on its own.
presetGuide.principle: Choose the preset by your Decision TF, the timeframe you make decisions on. It also drives every row of the MTF table.

decide.check: Periods count bars, not days, so use the settings most traders watch.

markets.note: SET50 index futures (TFEX). The lunch break makes 4H bars uneven, so 1H is used instead.
Open 23/5, so 5 daily bars a week: Classic, not Crypto. Stick to one data feed.
Daily stays the Decision TF even for swing, because of overnight and earnings gaps.
7 daily bars a week, so Crypto on Daily and above. Weekly needs about 3 years of data.

presetGuide.chartTf: The chart TF in the command is your Decision TF: Score, Zone, Kumo and Trend are read on it. Keep your TradingView chart on the same TF.
presetGuide.tfRows: TF rows other than 60 / 240 / D / W: put them in config.yaml (dashboard_tfs), or say them in the request, for example "TF rows 60/D/W/M".
save: config.yaml in the skill folder: preset, chart_tf and dashboard_tfs, before you zip and upload it.
Or your Claude project instructions or memory, for example "For BTCUSD use the Crypto preset on 1D".
presetGuide.cross: On Daily the guide pairs each preset with a second one. Run the skill twice and compare: if both read the same state, the reading is firmer; if they disagree, treat it as chop and wait.
presetGuide.manualNote: Settings guidance from the Ichimoku Itto manual. Starting points, not optimised values.

firstRun: Connect the TradingView connector in Claude, or have a CSV export or a chart screenshot ready.
Start a new chat and type a command.
Claude fetches 1H, 4H, 1D and 1W bars, runs the scripts and replies with the summary and the HTML report.
defaults: No setup questions first. It runs with the defaults (Quick mode, Classic preset 9/26/52/26, chart timeframe 1D), and the top of every report shows the settings used and the exact commands to change them. If a symbol trades on several exchanges, Claude asks once which one you mean.

commands.what: Every field, including Kumo Thin / Normal / Thick
Score / Zone / Kumo / Trend from the 4H bar

plainWords: Plain words work too, such as "read gold in detail". Add an exchange prefix (NASDAQ:AAPL) to skip the exchange question.

modes.note: Both modes give the same Score, Zone, Trend, timeframe rows and classic components. Add full to any command.

presets.name: 5-Day Week
presets.use: Markets that trade 5 days a week

liveBar: Like the indicator, the 1H / 4H / D / W rows use each timeframe's latest closed bar, while Score, Zone, Kumo and Trend use the live bar. A reading taken mid-bar can change before the bar closes.
otherInputs: Changed other inputs (Kijun slope, Strong threshold, Chop band, magnets)? Set the same values in config.yaml, or say them in the request.

routes.note: When it reads a chart, the skill only reads. It never changes your symbol, timeframe, layout, indicators, scripts, alerts or drawings.

Whether the timeframes agree, and in which direction.
The Ichimoku Itto table, labelled computed, or read from the chart or image.
One row per timeframe: Kumo, Tenkan/Kijun, Chikou, future Kumo, Sanyaku.
Close, Tenkan, Kijun and Kumo edges on one scale.

report.note: Classic means standard Ichimoku Kinkō Hyō knowledge. Itto means the Ichimoku Itto rules, taken from the open-source indicator code. Print the page to PDF from your browser if you need a file.

config:
jp_accents: true          # Japanese terms next to English names
mode: quick               # quick | full
chart_tf: 1D              # timeframe for Score / Zone / Kumo / Trend
dashboard_tfs: [1H, 4H, 1D, 1W]
preset: Classic           # Classic | 5-Day Week | Crypto
indicator_inputs: {kijun_slope: 5, strong_threshold: 4, chop_band: 1, magnet_flat_bars: 8, magnet_keep: 6}
symbol_defaults:          # skip the exchange question
  XAUUSD: OANDA:XAUUSD
  BTCUSD: BITSTAMP:BTCUSD
html_report: true
configText: config.yaml in the skill folder holds your defaults. Edit it before zipping, or simply say the setting in your request.

trouble.a: Check it is switched on in Customize → Skills and that code execution is on, then start a new chat.
Add the TradingView connector, or attach CSV exports or a screenshot.
Check the symbol and exchange, the preset and inputs, and whether the bar is still forming. In Quick mode, Kumo class shows "— (full mode)".

trouble.q: A ⚠ parity line in the report
trouble.a: The real dashboard and the computed one differ. The report lists which values; check the symbol, preset and inputs.
Upload the zip as downloaded, and do not rename the folder inside it.

faq.q: Does it give buy or sell signals?
faq.a: No. It reads state by principle. A built-in check blocks advice words before anything is shown, and every report ends with a disclaimer.

faq.q: Do I need TradingView Premium or the indicator on my chart?
faq.a: No. With the connector or CSV, the skill computes the dashboard itself. Add Ichimoku Itto on TradingView to see it and compare.
Anything with OHLCV data: forex, metals, crypto, stocks, indices and futures.
The scripts run inside Claude's code environment and make no network calls. Price data comes only from the route you use.
